source.author: verg
source.text: His addit Amastrum Hippotaden, sequiturque incumbens eminus hasta Tereaque Harpalycumque et Demophoonta Chrominque; quotque emissa manu contorsit spicula virgo, tot Phrygii cecidere viri.
source.text_original: His addit Amastrum / Hippotaden, sequiturque incumbens eminus hasta / Tereaque Harpalycumque et Demophoonta Chrominque; / quotque emissa manu contorsit spicula virgo, / tot Phrygii cecidere viri.
source.text_english: To these she adds Amastrus, son of Hippotas, and following close upon him, with spear from afar, Tereas and Harpalycus and Demophoon and Chromis; as many javelins as the maiden hurled from her hand, so many Phrygian men fell.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tum validam contorto turbine portam impulit Hippotades.
reuse.text_original: tum validam contorto turbine portam / impulit Hippotades.
reuse.text_english: Then Hippotas’ son drove against the stout gate with a whirling blast.
